text_block_list.text:
Katsuragi Ace finishes the Tenno Sho 
(Autumn). Having pushed each other to new 
heights through fierce competition, both 
already have their sights set on the next 
race.

The next stage is the Japan Cup. Triple 
Crown Umamusume Symboli Rudolf joins the 
fray, sending sparks flying.

The first Japan Cup victory by a Japanese 
Umamusume. A battle against two formidable 
rivals. A heavy pressure weighs down on 
Katsuragi Ace.

Panicking, she loses sight of her vision 
for victory. Just then, word arrives for 
the Trainer—a secret strategy to win the 
Japan Cup.
